steps.caption: Call Assistant
steps.narration: This is the Call Assistant. It answers calls on your ConstructHUB number and files every estimate request in your CRM.

steps.caption: Calls
steps.narration: Open Calls to see what it did with every call.

steps.caption: Every outcome, counted
steps.narration: Each tile is an outcome: estimate requests, calls sent to a person, questions answered, messages and spam.

steps.caption: The call log
steps.narration: Below, the call log lists each caller, the outcome, and what the call was about.

steps.caption: Open a call
steps.narration: Open a call to see what happened.

steps.caption: Saved in your CRM, office emailed
steps.narration: This caller was saved as a client with a project in your CRM, and the email to the office was accepted.

steps.caption: Summary and transcript
steps.narration: Under it is a short summary, then the full transcript.

steps.caption: Back to the log
steps.narration: Calls that need a person right away become escalations.

steps.caption: Escalations
steps.narration: Escalations lists the texts and emails the assistant sent to your team.

steps.caption: An urgent call, paged by text
steps.narration: This emergency paged Morgan Ellis by text. Delivery is uncertain, so automatic sends pause until you check.

steps.caption: Spam blocked
steps.narration: Spam blocked shows the sales pitches it screened out, so you never had to pick up.

steps.caption: Agent studio
steps.narration: In Agent studio you teach it your business: services, service area, hours and policies.

steps.caption: Persona
steps.narration: Persona picks the voice the assistant answers with.

steps.caption: Escalation rules
steps.narration: Escalations decide who gets paged for which calls, by text or email.

steps.caption: All tools
steps.narration: To get here from any tool, open All tools,

youtube.title: AI Call Assistant in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the AI Call Assistant in ConstructHUB: see the outcome of every call, open a call's summary and transcript and how it reached your CRM, follow escalations and blocked spam, and set the assistant's persona, greeting and escalation rules in Agent studio.
